author: Dillon Davis
text:
Our septic backed up into our showers and Allgood was the first of 4 companies to answer their phone. It was a real person, not a robot and that’s a win!

They made it out the next day, were priced more than fair, and dug a little extra without charging more, and they could have.

Great service, will use again!

author: mike ryan
text: Arnie was amazing and very efficient. Highly recommend

author: James Pearce
text: What an awesome man with a big heart. I needed my tank pumped ASAP and insured him I’d have it uncovered early morning next day. He showed up first thing and pumped it out. Great conversation as he worked. Great Christian man with a servants heart. This makes my second tank he’s done for me and I was just as pleased the first time but Google review didn’t exist. If I could award 10 stars I would.

author: kelly grubbs
text: Fast and friendly service! They came out the same day, which was such a relief. Ernie was incredibly professional, explained everything thoroughly, and made the whole process easy to understand. Very satisfied with the experience and would highly recommend!

author: Michelle P.
text: Ernie was a great help with our septic issue! Fast, efficient and very reasonable price. We definitely will be using All Good again soon in the future. All Good was recommended by my parents who have used as well and was very pleased with their service and we agree! Definitely recommend!
